internal.title: Incident Report: Elevated Error Rates in Checkout and Payment Services
internal.body:
At 11:04 UTC, an alert was triggered for high error rates in the checkout service. Initial diagnosis suggested error injection in the checkout service, but the proposal to disable error injection flags was blocked due to unknown flag errors. Subsequent diagnosis rounds identified high error rates in the payment service as well, with similar issues in flag handling preventing direct mitigation. The incident was escalated for further investigation and resolution.

Key events:
- 11:04:26: Alert received for high error rate in checkout.
- 11:24:12: Diagnosis round 1 focused on checkout error injection.
- 11:24:18: Proposal refused due to unknown flag.
- 11:24:27: Diagnosis round 3 focused on payment error injection.
- 11:24:48: Proposal refused due to missing dry run.

The root cause remains inconclusive due to blocked mitigation actions. Further investigation is ongoing.

external.title: Some customers experienced checkout issues
external.body: Between 11:04 and 11:25 UTC, some customers experienced issues completing their checkout process due to elevated error rates in our payment and checkout systems. Our engineering teams identified the problem and are actively working on a resolution. We apologize for any inconvenience caused and appreciate your patience as we resolve this issue.
